⚠️ **Why the relay, measured rather than assumed.** This container's egress proxy **replaces the Authorization header**: a deliberately bogus bearer still returned `200` and still resolved to `os-steve`, and every `/app*` path answers `403 "Access to this GitHub API path is not permitted through this proxy"`. ⇒ the App token can neither be minted here nor supplied from elsewhere, so direct writes would all book to a **user-to-server** identity — the exact shape `fleet-token.mjs`' header records as having got two seat accounts restricted in one day. The relay is the only route to the bot identity from a cloud seat.

## ④ Notes

**⭐ The finding that governs this round — the 2026-09-20 batch is undispatchable on its own terms.**

All **11** cards filed that day (#10145 #10084 #10083 #10078 #10074 #10073 #10072 #10071 #10069 #10068 #10066) report `comments: 1` in issue metadata but return **zero** comments over REST. Control on the same instrument: #9837 returns **4** ⇒ the zero is an absence the instrument could see, ⛔ not a dud. (MCP `get_comments` under-reports independently — #9837 gave 1 of 4 — so REST is the instrument of record here.)

Each of those cards carries: 「Re-measured at source by the triage seat … the claim below is CONFIRMED. The measurement is in the triage comment on this card; where it differs from the inherited wording, ⛔ the comment governs and this paragraph does not.」 ⇒ every one of them **defers its authority to a comment that does not exist**, and declares itself CONFIRMED by a measurement no one can read. ⛔ Dispatching any of them would send a dev on an unverified premise. Label+grade without the comment is a **half-state** by 「状态变更不过夜」. ⇒ routed to the triage seat for repair, ⛔ not dispatched from here.

**North-star clause 3, verified on the tree rather than inherited.** `契约卫生` resolves to **exactly one line** — `docs/NORTH-STAR.md:114` itself — with no definition and no mechanical reader; control word `工具卡` in the same instrument resolves to 4 sites (`core-rules.md:85`, `SKILL.md:123`, `decision-analysis.md:8`, NORTH-STAR itself) ⇒ the zero is real. ⇒ clause 3's **enforceable** half is the tooling one. Product P0 open = 4, P1 = 29 (read this act) ⇒ #8346 (`tooling`, p3, no `Unblocks:`) is **barred**, and the fleet's one `tooling` slot is already held by #8071.

**#9837 is the one clean dispatchable card**: ruled **A′** (batch #162 item 2, maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-18T12:18Z, comment `5729875984`), `Clause-②: no` per that ruling, and it is the declared gate for #10083.
